forbidden_layer_imports.reason: Reusable framework code cannot import repository tooling, tests, or documentation modules. Probe imports are rejected by the dedicated probe reverse-import rule.
Repository tools cannot acquire implementation or fixtures from the test suite.
The spine suite is the spine's. A test that needs an archived lane's code is that lane's test and lives in archive/tests/, where it still runs against the spine.
Canonical contract primitives may depend on project identity only, never on higher domain, control, runtime, or adapter layers.
External-world protocols may depend on stable identity contracts, never on their concrete adapters, orchestration, control, or validation implementations.
Evidence records cannot acquire retrieval implementation, validation, orchestration, or stage-control authority.
Research selection and indexing cannot depend on runtime orchestration, concrete adapters, validation, or control.
Material intent and binding validation cannot depend on project runners, orchestration, or concrete adapters.
The control plane consumes typed receipts but cannot depend on concrete adapters or runtime orchestration.
A read-only evaluator cannot acquire commit repository or hard-gate authority.
Hard validation cannot commit or depend on soft evaluation.
Detached experts and capabilities cannot acquire persistence or promotion authority.

The Studio API (P108, FastAPI BFF) validates requests, streams events and manages task lifecycle; design state, dependencies, validation, geometry and commit are calls into archflow. Geometry mathematics, graphs, .3dm writing and state schemas live in archflow and are imported, never reimplemented beside it. Pydantic models here are transport shapes, not a second canonical state.
